Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Shalini - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Savitri - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Nikhil: "What lovely weather!"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Shalini: "Good job!"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[The sun is blazing and Nikhil is sweating.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Shalini stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil throws the ball to Mother.]

Shalini: "Exactly right."

[Nikhil catches the ball.]

Nikhil (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Nikhil kicks the football hard.]

Shalini: "Good job, Nikhil!"

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Mom, look at this."

[Nikhil plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Nikhil stands in the kitchen. Shalini stands near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look over here."

[Nikhil makes tea for everyone.]

Nikhil (surprised): "That's great!"

[Nikhil washes the dishes after dinner.]

Shalini: "Yes, of course."

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Shalini and Savitri stand near him.]

Shalini: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil gulps down a glass of milk.]

Shalini: "Really?"

[Nikhil serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Nikhil (happily): "What a day to remember!"
